name: RCS 2345-3632 (Hubble)
blurb: RCS 2345-3632, a distant galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: rcs23453632-hubble
story: A distant, rich cluster of galaxies, discovered by the Red-sequence Cluster Survey. Hubble looked here to map the stars in its member galaxies and learn how massive cluster galaxies formed.

claims.text: RCS 2345-3632 is an optically rich galaxy cluster at redshift 1.04
RCS clusters were mostly discovered in the Red-sequence Cluster Survey
RCS234526-3632.6 (z = 1.04) was a target of HST program 13687, which studies the formation of massive cluster galaxies with stellar mass maps
